description: This file serves as the server-side rendering entry point for a Qwik-based web application. It imports rendering functions and components, defines a default function that renders the root component with specified options, and exports this function as the main export to handle server rendering in various environments.

methods.name: default
methods.description: An exported default function that takes rendering options, calls 'renderToStream' with the Root component and combined options, and manages server-side rendering attributes.
